comment: Reviewed security-weakening matches found by tools/Test-SecurityWeakening.ps1. Each entry must match one line exactly. Add an entry only after review, with the reason it is acceptable.

entries.reason: Restore Default fallback for Credential Guard when no pre-Apply snapshot exists (applied by an older version); the confirmation text says it then turns the feature off.
Restore Default for the opt-in System Guard Secure Launch tweak, which is off by default.
Restore Default fallback for Credential Guard when no pre-Apply snapshot exists; with a snapshot the saved values are restored instead.

Opt-in compatibility exclusion of a fixed list of developer tools (Git, MSYS2, GitHub Desktop) from mandatory ASLR.
Restore Default for system-wide mandatory ASLR, which Windows ships turned off.
Restore Default for the per-app Office/Acrobat mitigations the Apply side adds; they are off by default.
Hardening Apply: turns SMB encryption and signing on; RejectUnencryptedAccess stays off only so clients without SMB 3 encryption can still connect with signing.

entries.match: W001	+	# Disable Windows Update via peer-to-peer (Category: Windows Update)
entries.reason: Only turns off peer-to-peer delivery; updates still download from Microsoft.

entries.match: W011	+	# Disable updates to the speech recognition and speech synthesis modules. (Category: Windows Update)
entries.reason: Speech model downloads only; security updates are not affected.
